verses: The Gospel of Truth is a Gnostic text from the Nag Hammadi Library, attributed to the Valentinian teacher Valentinus.
The gospel of truth is joy for those who have received from the Father of truth the grace of knowing him through the power of the Word.
The Word who is called the Savior, since that is the name of the work he is to perform for the redemption of those who did not know the Father.
For the All was searching for the one from whom it had come forth, and the All was inside him, the incomprehensible, inconceivable one.
Ignorance of the Father brought about anguish and terror; the anguish grew solid like a fog, so that no one could see.
Error became powerful; she worked on her own matter vainly, not having known the truth. She set about making a creation.
The thought of the Father, which is the hidden wisdom, brought forth knowledge. The one hidden in the Father was revealed by the Father's will.
He revealed himself and poured himself out, giving form to those who were formless. He gave them a way to the Father.
The Son, who is in the Father and who is the Father, revealed the invisible one who is hidden within the Father.
The Son alone knows the Father, and he revealed him as he wished to be known. The Father is known through his grace.
The Word came forth from the fullness, rejoicing in the grace of the Father. He was established as a seal for all.
He taught them about the Father. He gave them minds and opened the ears of those who were deaf to the truth.
He called them to knowledge of the one who is. He drove out the error that was in them and entered them.
He emptied them of what was empty and filled them with what was full. He became a guide, peaceful and leisurely.
He appeared in the schools, speaking the word of truth and teaching those who were wise. But the wise in their own eyes came to test him.
He confounded them because they were foolish. They hated him because they were not really wise. He was a stranger to them.
They brought him to trial and condemned him to death. He was nailed to a tree.
He became a fruit of the knowledge of the Father. He did not cause destruction for those who ate of him, but caused them to rejoice.
For he discovered them in himself, and they discovered him in themselves — the incomprehensible, inconceivable Father.
The one who is to bring forth the perfect light is the knowledge of the heart, which arises from the will of the Father.
The gospel is the revelation of the fullness, the discovery of the light that is in the Father.
The Father sent his Son into the world, so that he might strip it of its ignorance and clothe it with knowledge.
Those who know the Father will not taste death. They will live forever in the knowledge of the truth.
The Father is good and loves humanity. He makes his sun rise on the righteous and the unrighteous.
The one who knows the truth is free, and the one who is free does not sin. For sin is bondage, and knowledge is liberation.
The Father calls those who know him to return to him. He prepares a place for them in the fullness.
He who is perfect in knowledge will be perfect in rest. He will enter into the bridal chamber of the Father.
The Father's will is that all should be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth. This is the perfection of the All.
This is the word of the gospel: that the Father has revealed himself to those who love him.
The one who does the will of the Father abides in the Father, and the Father abides in him.
The mystery of the Father is beyond all comprehension. Yet he has revealed it to the children of light.
The name of the Father is above every name. It is the name that the Son revealed to those who were worthy.
The children of the Father are those who have come to know him through the Son. They have received the light of knowledge.
They have put off the garments of ignorance and have clothed themselves with the light of truth.
The way of the Father is the way of life. Those who walk in it will not stumble.
The Father is the beginning and the end. He is the one from whom all things come and to whom all things return.
The Son is the revelation of the Father. Through him, the invisible becomes visible.
Those who have received the knowledge of the truth have received the perfection of the Father.
The gospel of truth is a call to all who are asleep, that they may awaken and see the light of the Father.
Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will give you light.
The one who has ears to hear, let him hear the call of the Father.
For the truth is the revelation of the Father. It is the light that shines in the hearts of those who love him.
Let those who have found the truth give thanks to the Father, for he has revealed himself to them.
For the Father is good, and his mercy endures forever. He has called us to knowledge, to life, to rest in him. Amen.
